scenes.text: a real working photo studio: warm sand seamless paper backdrop with a soft wrinkle and slight colour unevenness, the edge of the paper roll just visible on one side, one or two faint tape marks on the concrete floor
a daylight studio with a cream lime-plaster wall showing natural trowel unevenness and a hairline crack, worn wooden floorboards with scuffs and gaps, soft window light from the left

a lived-in London townhouse room: herringbone parquet with visible wear near the door, slightly scuffed cream panelled walls, an old radiator under the sash window, faint dust motes in the window light
an old stone staircase with worn hollowed steps, chipped edges, uneven warm patina on the stone, a simple iron handrail with small paint losses
a real evening living room: a warm table lamp with its cord visible, a small stack of books slightly askew, honest soft shadows on an espresso-toned wall, lived-in atmosphere

the honest backstage of a fashion shoot: a clothes rail with a few garment bags softly out of focus behind her, a garment steamer in the corner, cardboard boxes near the wall, real working-space clutter

poses: caught mid-turn toward the camera, chin slightly lifted, the skirt of the dress still swinging from the movement
in the act of sitting down gracefully, back long and straight, one hand smoothing the dress under her
walking past the window mid-stride, posture tall and open, one arm in natural swing
standing tall while fastening an earring, elbows lifted, gaze calm past the camera
rising from a seated position with a long straight back, weight on one leg, the dress settling around her
looking back over her shoulder toward the camera, spine elegant, one hand gathering her hair off her neck
leaning her shoulder blades back against the wall, one knee bent, chin level, arms relaxed
rules: Warm desaturated palette only (sand, cream, taupe, espresso). NEVER cold grey, never loud colors. The location is REAL and lived-in: honest imperfections in the set, background rendered with true optical depth of field from a 50mm lens, never painted-looking blur. No mirrors. No smile (composed, serene). No text, no logos, no other people.
